description: When insiders' shares from recent IPOs may be sold, from each company's final prospectus (424B4). Across the market, the lock-ups ending in a window: company, IPO date, length as stated (usually 180 days), the date it counts from and the expiry computed from it, staged releases, early-release triggers (earnings release, share price), shares locked up and shares sold. For one company, its terms quoted and later filings that waive or release them.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name: its IPO's lock-up terms quoted from the final prospectus, and later filings that waive or release them. Without it, the IPO lock-ups across the market that end in the window.

days.description: Across the market, the window's length in days from today (or from since); default 60.

limit.description: Across the market, most lock-ups listed, earliest first; default 25.

since.description: Across the market, the window's first day (YYYY-MM-DD), for a past or later window; default today.

name: lockup_calendar

outputSchema.description: rows are lock-ups in the order of columns, earliest first: expiry is counted from the date the prospectus's words name (counts_from, base_date), and early-release rows have none; quotes are exact sentences from the final prospectus; changes lists later filings that say the lock-up was waived or shares released.

title: IPO lock-up expiries (from the prospectus)
